name: IC 4030 (Webb)
blurb: IC 4030, a galaxy in the Coma Cluster, seen by Webb.
label: ic4030-webb
story: One of the large galaxies of the Coma Cluster, a key touchstone for the cosmic distance scale. Webb read the surface brightness fluctuations in its light, a distance measure that aims to match the precision of exploding stars known as Type Ia supernovae.

claims.text: IC 4030 is one of the large galaxies in the Coma Cluster targeted by Webb program 5989
The Coma Cluster is the nearest rich cluster and a key touchstone for the distance scale
Webb measured surface brightness fluctuations (SBF) to build a distance ladder aimed at the Hubble constant
SBF aims at precision comparable to Type Ia supernovae
